#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""RoboTwin limited-mode bottle placement controller.

The default run executes a camera-guided sequence.  Use ``--console`` to keep
one Robot connection open while issuing individual poses during an episode.
All commanded object coordinates come from calibrated RGB/depth observations;
no simulator object state is queried.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import pathlib
import sys
import time

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import EpisodeOver, Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
RUNS = OUT / "actions"
SIDE_Q = np.array([math.sqrt(0.5), 0.0, 0.0, math.sqrt(0.5)], np.float32)
SIDE_AXIS = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0], np.float32)


class Controller:
    def __init__(self):
        self.r = Robot()
        self.call = 0
        print("connected", self.r.spec()["protocol"], self.r.spec()["robot"], flush=True)

    def observe(self, cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera"),
                depth=False, seconds=0.0, video="none"):
        o = self.r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, seconds=seconds, video=video)
        print("OBS", json.dumps({"step": o.meta.get("step"), "sim_time_s": o.meta.get("sim_time_s"),
                                 "time_left_s": o.meta.get("time_left_s"),
                                 "done": o.meta.get("done"), "reason": o.meta.get("reason")}), flush=True)
        return o

    @staticmethod
    def now(o):
        return np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)

    @staticmethod
    def tcp(o, arm):
        n = Controller.now(o)
        start = 56 if arm == "left" else 63
        return n[start:start + 7].copy()

    @staticmethod
    def ee(o, arm):
        n = Controller.now(o)
        start = 14 if arm == "left" else 21
        return n[start:start + 7].copy()

    @staticmethod
    def opening(o, arm):
        n = Controller.now(o)
        return float(n[36 if arm == "left" else 43])

    def save_result(self, res, tag):
        self.call += 1
        where = RUNS / f"{self.call:03d}_{tag}"
        res.save(str(where))
        print("ACTION", json.dumps({"tag": tag, "done": res.meta.get("done"),
                                    "reason": res.meta.get("reason"),
                                    "plan": res.meta.get("plan"),
                                    "clipped": res.meta.get("clipped"),
                                    "sim_time_s": res.meta.get("sim_time_s"),
                                    "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"),
                                    "saved": str(where)}), flush=True)
        return res

    def move_tcp(self, arm, tcp_xyz, q=SIDE_Q, grip=None, other_grip=None, tag="move"):
        """Plan to a TCP (finger-centre) target; EE is offset 12 cm behind it."""
        o = self.observe()
        n = self.now(o)
        left = np.r_[n[14:21], n[28]].astype(np.float32)
        right = np.r_[n[21:28], n[29]].astype(np.float32)
        g = np.asarray(q, np.float32)
        g /= max(float(np.linalg.norm(g)), 1e-8)
        # The end-effector frame sits 12 cm behind the gripper along its local
        # +x approach axis. Rotate that axis into the world for this pose.
        w, x, y, z = map(float, g)
        approach = np.array([1 - 2 * (y*y + z*z), 2 * (x*y + w*z),
                             2 * (x*z - w*y)], np.float32)
        target_ee = np.asarray(tcp_xyz, np.float32) - 0.12 * approach
        own = left if arm == "left" else right
        other = right if arm == "left" else left
        own[:3] = target_ee
        own[3:7] = g
        if grip is not None:
            own[7] = float(grip)
        if other_grip is not None:
            other[7] = float(other_grip)
        row = np.r_[left, right][None, :]
        res = self.r.submit("ee_pose", row, video="both", video_fps=10,
                            note=f"{tag}: {arm} tcp {np.round(tcp_xyz,3).tolist()}")
        self.save_result(res, tag)
        if res.meta.get("done"):
            return res
        check = self.observe(cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera"))
        print("STATE", json.dumps({"left_tcp": np.round(self.tcp(check, "left")[:3], 4).tolist(),
                                   "right_tcp": np.round(self.tcp(check, "right")[:3], 4).tolist(),
                                   "left_grip": self.opening(check, "left"),
                                   "right_grip": self.opening(check, "right")}), flush=True)
        return res

    def set_gripper(self, arm, value, tag="gripper"):
        o = self.observe()
        n = self.now(o)
        left = np.r_[n[14:21], n[28]].astype(np.float32)
        right = np.r_[n[21:28], n[29]].astype(np.float32)
        (left if arm == "left" else right)[7] = float(value)
        res = self.r.submit("ee_pose", np.r_[left, right][None, :], video="both",
                            video_fps=10, note=f"{tag}: {arm} gripper {value}")
        self.save_result(res, tag)
        o2 = self.observe()
        print("GRIP", arm, "cmd", value, "measured", self.opening(o2, arm), flush=True)
        return res

    def watch(self, seconds=1.0, tag="watch"):
        o = self.r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video="both", video_fps=10)
        self.call += 1
        where = RUNS / f"{self.call:03d}_{tag}"
        o.save(str(where))
        print("WATCH", json.dumps({"tag": tag, "sim_time_s": o.meta.get("sim_time_s"),
                                   "time_left_s": o.meta.get("time_left_s"),
                                   "done": o.meta.get("done"), "reason": o.meta.get("reason"),
                                   "saved": str(where)}), flush=True)
        return o

    def console(self):
        print("commands: obs [depth], tcp ARM X Y Z [grip], tcpq ARM X Y Z QW QX QY QZ [grip], grip ARM VALUE, watch SECONDS, quit", flush=True)
        while True:
            try:
                line = input("rcb> ").strip()
            except EOFError:
                break
            if not line:
                continue
            p = line.split()
            try:
                if p[0] in ("quit", "exit"):
                    break
                if p[0] == "obs":
                    self.observe(depth=(len(p) > 1 and p[1] == "depth"), video="none")
                elif p[0] == "tcp" and len(p) in (5, 6):
                    g = None if len(p) == 5 else float(p[5])
                    self.move_tcp(p[1], list(map(float, p[2:5])), grip=g, tag="console_tcp")
                elif p[0] == "tcpq" and len(p) in (9, 10):
                    xyz = list(map(float, p[2:5]))
                    q = list(map(float, p[5:9]))
                    g = None if len(p) == 9 else float(p[9])
                    self.move_tcp(p[1], xyz, q=q, grip=g, tag="console_tcpq")
                elif p[0] == "grip" and len(p) == 3:
                    self.set_gripper(p[1], float(p[2]), tag="console_grip")
                elif p[0] == "watch" and len(p) == 2:
                    self.watch(float(p[1]))
                else:
                    print("unrecognized command", flush=True)
            except (EpisodeOver, Exception) as e:
                print("ERROR", type(e).__name__, str(e), flush=True)
                if isinstance(e, EpisodeOver):
                    break


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--console", action="store_true", help="manual episode console using one connection")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    c = Controller()
    if args.console:
        c.console()
    else:
        # The task sequence is filled in after the first observed grasp confirms
        # the scene-specific TCP calibration and gripper convention.
        c.observe(cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "observer_camera", "world_camera1"),
                  depth=True, video="none")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
